events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released 51 years ago today in 1975.

angles.name: Enduring Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. What's the enduring message of this classic album for you?

events.title: Sting Turns 75
events.blurb: Gordon Sumner, known worldwide as Sting, the legendary frontman of The Police and successful solo artist, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Sting's Legacy
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Sting! From The Police to his solo career, what's your favourite track or memory of him?

events.title: The iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple released the first-generation iPod 25 years ago today in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? 25 years ago, it changed everything. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic British secret agent and the enduring film franchise.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! We're celebrating 007's legacy. Which Bond film, actor, or theme tune is your all-time favourite?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend, John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Sending birthday wishes to the brilliant John Cleese, turning 87 today! What's your favourite moment from his incredible career?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released 58 years ago today in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Tracks
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years of 'The White Album'! Such a diverse collection of tracks. Which one is your go-to?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie's Impact
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury on the anniversary of his passing. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released 61 years ago today in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Influence
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since 'Rubber Soul' dropped. An album that changed the game for The Beatles. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon. His music and spirit continue to resonate globally.

events.title: David Bowie Would Have Been 80
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 80th birthday of the visionary artist David Bowie.

angles.name: Bowie's Influence
angles.copy: Remembering David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. A true innovator whose influence is still felt everywhere.

events.title: Elvis Presley Would Have Been 92

angles.name: King's Legacy
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley on what would have been his 92nd birthday. The King lives on!

events.title: Jimmy Page Turns 83

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! A true guitar god whose riffs defined an era.

events.title: Rod Stewart Turns 82

angles.name: Rod the Mod's Day
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! What's your favourite song from his incredible career?

events.title: Suggs Turns 66

angles.name: Madness Legend
